caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of fabric with an embroidered design composed of pink and blue threadwork on a light brown, coarse-textured background. The central motif consists of a symmetrical, radiating arrangement: four large, fan-shaped forms alternate between pink and blue, creating a cross-like pattern. These fan shapes are filled with floral and leaf patterns. At the exact center, dark blue thread forms a dense, floral motif with symmetrical branches spreading outward. Between the fan shapes and near the corners of the square are small, blue, diamond-shaped elements. In each corner, there are smaller blue and pink floral or leaf motifs that resemble quarter circles. The fabric is mounted on a white background, and there is a small, faint mark or signature at the bottom right outside the fabric area. The overall composition is geometric and symmetric, dominated by alternating sections of blue and pink embroidery against the natural brown color of the fabric.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
